title: Tue 13 Oct 2026: Asian chip sell-off, BoE November hike priced, FCA illiquid fund redemption proposal, FCA Connect deadline
summary: Chipmakers drag Asian markets lower as Wall Street splits, with oil above one hundred dollars after weekend strikes in Saudi Arabia. A Bank of England hike on 5 November is heavily priced ahead of US inflation and UK GDP, while the FCA proposes notice periods for funds holding illiquid assets and fund applications move to Connect on 2 November. Plus ETF closures, three COO action points and the diary.
